_: Single owner of how an agent reaches a model. Read by Nix (modules/gateway.nix) and by Guile (guix/home-configuration.scm). Rationale and vocabulary: CONTEXT.md; seam decision: docs/adr/0001-gateway-facts-cross-the-guix-seam-as-json.md. Nothing here is a secret -- only the name of one.
_models: Addressing's other half: which ids exist, and the ceilings a harness must respect to hold them. Was duplicated across pi's models.json on M-02877 and Caveman Code's on mahakala, and the two disagreed (home-manager-8vh). Slot names are roles a harness asks for; ids are what the gateway publishes. contextWindow and maxTokens are the gateway's own enforced ceilings, measured 2026-09-19: it names its limit in the 400 body, both for max_tokens ('N > M, which is the maximum allowed number of output tokens') and for an oversized prompt ('prompt is too long: N tokens > M maximum'). GET /v1/models is not served (404), so a probe is the only first-hand source; re-measure rather than edit from memory. cost is the registry rate in USD per million tokens (data-zone band), from GET https://app.genai.thelegogroup.com/models, read 2026-10-14. That API takes an Entra token: az account get-access-token --scope api://917243ee-d114-44a7-bb10-09ae72bf100d/.default. Opus 5.5 cache reads cost 5% of input, and cache writes cost 25 times a read, so a lost prompt cache is the largest cost.

haiku._reasoning: Stays false: a configured thinking level on Haiku 4.5 trips 'adaptive thinking is not supported on this model' (LEGO/ai-model-gateway-client, src/features/docs/pages/PiPage.tsx).
haiku.name: Haiku 4.5 (LEGO)

_promptCache: The provider's prompt-cache lifetime in seconds, for every Claude model above: the 5-minute ephemeral cache. pi keeps a cache warm during a long tool run only when the model has a lifetime and a cost (pi docs/settings.md, cacheWarming).

headroom._workspaceDir: Headroom keeps all of its state under HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR: the savings ledgers (proxy_savings.json, savings_events.jsonl), the CCR store, TOIN, logs. The image's VOLUME is /home/nonroot/.headroom while it runs as root with HOME=/root (headroomlabs-ai/headroom#4443), so without this everything but proxy_savings.json lived in the container layer and reset at each --rm restart (den#62). The memory DB defaults to {cwd}/.headroom/memory.db, so it gets its own path under the same directory.
headroom._allowUnauthenticatedBind: Headroom images from 2026-10 refuse to bind 0.0.0.0 unless HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN is set, because their /v1/* routes would relay the caller's gateway credential to anyone who can reach the port. A token does not fit here: the harnesses already send the gateway key as the Authorization bearer, so a second bearer would collide with it. The image's documented alternative is this acknowledgement. It is honest only while every host publishes the port on loopback (published.*.host); on the container network, only our own sibling containers can reach it. Measured 2026-10-06: without it headroom exits at start.
